impact.text: This affects ALL limit order matching (both partial and full matches)

precondition_sources.text: A limit order match (partial or full) is being processed through _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder.
The matched base amount and matched quote amount have no overlapping 1-bits (e.g., base = 256 and quote in 1..255, or 40 & 21).

intent_sources.text: The zero-cost trade check must only reject trades where one side receives tokens without sending any, not legitimate trades whose amounts have disjoint bits.
Legitimate limit order matches with nonzero amounts on both sides must not revert with ZeroCostTrade().
